tools.name: search_airports
tools.description: Finds airports by city, airport name, country or IATA code. Returns each airport with its three-letter IATA code, city, country and a link to the airport page with every destination served from it.

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: Everything known about flying from one airport to another: whether a nonstop flight exists and which airlines fly it, flight time, distance, the cheapest dates with their fares, the lowest fare per month, and where fares with stops change planes. tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: Where you can fly from an airport, cheapest first: each destination with its lowest one-way fare, whether the flight is nonstop, the airline and the flight time. Answers questions like "where can I fly from Cluj for under 50 dollars" or "nonstop destinations from Lisbon".

tools.name: find_connections
tools.description: Ways to get between two airports that have no convenient nonstop flight, built from nonstop legs seen in recent fare results: where to change planes, the airlines, flight time and lowest fare of each leg. The legs are separate tickets, with no guaranteed connection between them.
